# PyTorch Lightning reproducibility. I’m experiencing an issue with reproducibility in PyTorch Lightning. Despite setting `deterministic=True`, `pl.seed_everything(42)` and `workers=True`, I’m getting different validation losses for the same epoch when changing the number of epochs in the trainer. For example, when I set the number of epochs to 1, I get a validation loss of 5.89, but when I set it to 2, I get a validation loss of 5.13 on the first epoch. I’ve verified that the results are reproducible when running the same number of epochs multiple times (get the same sequence of validation losses), but changing the number of epochs yields different results for the same epoch. What is the cause of this behavior and is there a way to ensure reproducible results across different numbers of epochs?
